headline_item.title_zh: 美国国家安全局核心内网NSA Net中断
headline_item.title_en: Sources: NSA Net, the highly classified network that the NSA uses for its internal communications, is down; there is no evidence of a cyberattack (CNN)
headline_item.event_summary_zh: 美国国家安全局（NSA）内部机密通信网络NSA Net出现大范围中断，目前暂无网络攻击迹象
headline_item.event_summary_en: The NSA Net, the internal classified network of the National Security Agency, has experienced a service outage, prompting the agency to implement staggered personnel arrivals. Current internal assessments indicate no evidence of an external cyberattack.
core_facts_zh: 【核心事件】美国国家安全局（NSA）在美国政府内部机密通信基础设施：NSA Net系统运行中断，机构采取错峰办公措施
【起因与机理】排查系统故障范围与维持内部通信安全
【核心事实细节】NSA内部机密通信网络发生服务中断。
【各方立场与态度】机构正通过调整人员入场节奏控制运维压力。
core_facts_en: [Core Event] National Security Agency (NSA): NSA Net outage and implementation of staggered work schedules
[Root Cause & Mechanism] To investigate the scope of the issue and maintain internal communication security
[Key Fact Detail] NSA internal classified network outage.
[Key Position & Outlook] Implementation of staggered staffing as a contingency measure.
headline_item.industry_impact_zh: 核心机密通信设施的意外宕机反映出高度受限的封闭环境在系统冗余与实时运维上的脆弱性，即便排除外部攻击，此类基础设施的高可用性仍是情报机构保持政令畅通的阿喀琉斯之踵。
headline_item.industry_impact_en: The unexpected downtime of a core classified network highlights the fragility of high-security isolated environments in terms of system redundancy and real-time maintenance. Even in the absence of an external attack, high availability remains a critical vulnerability for intelligence agencies.

headlines.title_zh: 美国土安全部：技术故障多源于老旧系统
headlines.title_en: DHS Secretary Markwayne Mullin says recent tech outages are not tied to cyberattacks but to "pushing new technology on top of really old computer systems" (David Shepardson/Reuters)
headlines.event_summary_zh: 美国国土安全部部长Markwayne Mullin表示，近期一系列科技基础设施故障并非网络攻击，而是老旧系统兼容性瓶颈所致
headlines.event_summary_en: US Secretary of Homeland Security Markwayne Mullin stated that recent tech infrastructure outages were not linked to cyberattacks. The root cause is the integration of new-generation technologies onto fundamentally antiquated computer systems, leading to architectural instability.
core_facts_zh: 【核心事件】美国国土安全部（DHS）部长Markwayne Mullin在公共安全与基础设施管理语境：将近期技术故障归因于老旧系统与新技术叠加的架构矛盾
【起因与机理】澄清外界对网络攻击的误读，揭示关键基础设施的技术债务压力
【核心事实细节】否定近期技术故障与网络攻击有关。
【行业影响与走向】警示在老旧系统上过度叠加新技术存在重大风险。
core_facts_en: [Core Event] US Secretary of Homeland Security Markwayne Mullin: Attributed recent tech outages to architectural conflicts between old systems and new tech
[Root Cause & Mechanism] Clarify misconceptions regarding cyberattacks and highlight technical debt in critical infrastructure
[Regulatory & Investigation Focus] Denial of cyberattack involvement in recent outages.
[Industry Impact & Outlook] Warning of risks associated with layering new tech on legacy systems.
headlines.industry_impact_zh: 美国关键基础设施面临的并非全是外部安全威胁，更严峻的挑战在于长期堆叠带来的技术债务危机；将新技术部署于遗产系统（Legacy Systems）导致的系统性崩溃，已成为制约公共部门数字化转型的核心瓶颈。
headlines.industry_impact_en: Critical US infrastructure faces not only external security threats but also severe technical debt crises from incremental stacking. The systemic failure resulting from deploying new technologies atop legacy systems has become a primary bottleneck for public sector digital transformation.

headlines.title_zh: 稳定币支付平台Codex获3千万美元融资
headlines.title_en: Codex, which lets businesses use stablecoins for cross-border payments across Asia, Latin America, and sub-Saharan Africa, raised a $30M Series A led by Pantera (Camila Grigera Naón/Fortune)
headlines.event_summary_zh: 跨境稳定币支付基础设施提供商Codex完成3000万美元A轮融资，估值达1.3亿美元，Pantera Capital领投
headlines.event_summary_en: Delaware-based Codex secured $30 million in a Series A round led by Pantera Capital at a $1.3 billion post-money valuation. The company is building cross-border payment infrastructure using stablecoins to address friction in Asia, Latin America, and Sub-Saharan Africa, with plans to integrate AI agents for FX automation to reduce transaction costs.
core_facts_zh: 【核心事件】Codex（CEO：李浩南）在一级市场跨境金融基础设施赛道：完成3000万美元A轮融资，估值达1.3亿美元
【起因与机理】利用稳定币解决跨境支付结算中的高成本与碎片化问题
【关键数据与实测】获得3000万美元A轮融资，估值1.3亿美元。
【各方立场与态度】计划引入AI代理技术实现外汇自动化以应对交易规模增长。
core_facts_en: [Core Event] Codex (CEO: Haonan Li): Raised $30M Series A at $130M valuation
[Root Cause & Mechanism] To solve high costs and fragmentation in cross-border settlements using stablecoins
[Key Metrics] $30M Series A financing at $130M valuation.
[Key Position & Outlook] Expansion plan: integrating AI agents to automate FX and scale transaction volumes.
headlines.industry_impact_zh: 稳定币在跨境支付端的渗透已进入基础设施竞争阶段，Codex通过AI代理实现外汇自动化，旨在打破碎片化的汇兑壁垒；其核心策略在于通过技术手段降低高通胀国家及新兴市场的金融门槛，直接冲击传统SWIFT结算系统的长周期与高费用模式。
headlines.industry_impact_en: Stablecoin adoption for cross-border payments has entered the infrastructure competition stage, with Codex leveraging AI agents to automate foreign exchange and break down fragmentation. Their strategy focuses on lowering financial barriers in high-inflation and emerging markets, directly challenging the latency and high costs of traditional SWIFT settlement models.

titans.name: Aravind Srinivas
titans.event_context_zh:
落和其他物体，到达挑战者深渊，一路上浏览 18 个发现。

屏幕上的所有内容都是代码。 Teammate 自己编写了 WebGPU 渲染器，没有游戏引擎，也没有 Three.js，并且无需导入任何模型、纹理或音频文件即可生成地形、海藻、生物、潜艇和声音。所有内容都包含在一个 373 KB HTML 文件中。

Ultra Effort 上有 36,000 个 Perplexity 积分（Fable 5.2 High 作为协调器）。
titans.event_context_en: Teammate on Fable 5.2 made HADAL, a dive into the Mariana Trench you can play in a browser tab at https://t.co/wgZHPEaeR
titans.quote_zh:
《神鬼寓言 5.2》中的队友制作了《HADAL》，这是一款潜入马里亚纳海沟的游戏，您可以在浏览器选项卡中玩 。你首先是一名水肺潜水员，在阳光明媚的珊瑚礁上，登上一艘潜艇，一路向下经过沉船、鲸鱼坠落和其他物体，到达挑战者深渊，一路上浏览 18 个发现。

屏幕上的所有内容都是代码。 Teammate 自己编写了 WebGPU 渲染器，没有游戏引擎，也没有 Three.js，并且无需导入任何模型、纹理或音频文件即可生成地形、海藻、生物、潜艇和声音。所有内容都包含在一个 373 KB HTML 文件中。

Ultra Effort 上有 36,000 个 Perplexity 积分（Fable 5.2 High 作为协调器）。
titans.quote_en:
Teammate on Fable 5.2 made HADAL, a dive into the Mariana Trench you can play in a browser tab at https://t.co/wgZHPEaeRy. You start as a scuba diver on a sunlit reef, board a submarine, and work your way down past shipwrecks, a whale fall and other things to Challenger Deep, scanning 18 discoveries as you go.

Everything on screen is code. Teammate wrote the WebGPU renderer itself, with no game engine and no Three.js, and generated the terrain, kelp, creatures, submarine and sound without a single imported model, texture or audio file. It all fits in one 373 KB HTML file.

36,000 Perplexity credits on Ultra Effort (Fable 5.2 High as orchestrator).
